result.title: RL Teaches VLMs Where to Attend but Not How to Perceive
result.summary: Although reinforcement learning (RL) effectively trains Vision-Language Model (VLM) agents, the mechanisms behind these capability gains are poorly understood. Across four diverse agent environments, we investigate whether the task-success gains from multi-turn RL are accompanied by improved grounded visual question answering about the environment. To assess this, we design environment-specific grounded VQA tasks that reveal improvements in grounded visual understanding. Representational probing shows that vision-encoder probe accuracy remains relatively stable, while LLM-layer probe accuracy improves. Attention analysis further reveals that LLM layers pay more attention to visual tokens during RL training. To test whether increased attention to visual tokens contributes to VQA gains, we introduce a lightweight plug-and-play intervention using a fixed attention bias. Without updating model parameters or computing gradients, this intervention partially restores VQA gains on the untrained model. These results reveal better utilization of visual information as a key mechanism behind the gains from RL.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在四个智能体环境中考察多轮 RL 带来的任务成功率提升是否伴随环境相关的视觉问答改善，并用表示探针与注意力分析追查机制。结果显示视觉编码器探针准确率基本不变，而 LLM 层探针提升、对视觉 token 的注意力增强；一个不更新参数、不加梯度的固定注意力偏置干预可部分恢复未训练模型的 VQA 增益，据此认为 RL 主要改善视觉信息的利用而非感知本身。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接关系「答案是否真正使用视觉内容」、视觉旁路与注意力结构问题，为「latent 状态是否保留并调用视觉证据」提供诊断证据，并给出可供核查的免训练注意力干预线索。
